A look at the day's college football action, featuring news, highlights and game previews.

20:30 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: College Football
The Florida Atlantic Owls (5-3) host the UTSA Roadrunners (7-1) for a regular-season matchup at Flagler Credit Union Stadium. UTSA seeks a sixth straight win behind Owen McCown, while the Owls look to Caden Veltkamp after a 48-41 loss to North Texas.
